auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Zenkit API key sent in the Zenkit-API-Key header. Generate or copy it from your Zenkit profile: https://base.zenkit.com/docs/api/overview/authentication.

actions.name: create_entry
actions.description: Create an entry in a Zenkit collection with collection-defined field values.

listId.description: The numeric ID of the collection that will contain the entry.

data.description: Collection field values keyed by the Zenkit field UUID and business data key.

anyOf.description: A named sort position such as highest or lowest.

sortOrder.description: The entry sort position as a number, or highest or lowest.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for creating a Zenkit entry.

entry.description: The raw object returned by Zenkit.

actions.name: delete_entry
actions.description: Delete an entry from a Zenkit collection.

anyOf.description: The collection numeric ID, short ID, UUID, or name.
The collection numeric ID, short ID, UUID, or name.

listId.description: The collection numeric ID, short ID, UUID, or name.

anyOf.description: The entry numeric ID, short ID, UUID, or name.
The entry numeric ID, short ID, UUID, or name.

entryId.description: The entry numeric ID, short ID, UUID, or name.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for deleting a Zenkit entry.

deleted.description: Whether Zenkit accepted the delete operation.

response.description: The response payload returned by Zenkit, if any.

outputSchema.description: The result of deleting a Zenkit entry.

anyOf.description: The collection numeric ID, short ID, UUID, or name.

listId.description: The collection numeric ID, short ID, UUID, or name.

anyOf.description: The entry numeric ID, short ID, UUID, or name.
The entry numeric ID, short ID, UUID, or name.

entryId.description: The entry numeric ID, short ID, UUID, or name.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for retrieving a Zenkit entry.

entry.description: The raw object returned by Zenkit.

actions.name: get_list
actions.description: Get a Zenkit collection by its numeric ID, short ID, UUID, or name.

anyOf.description: The collection numeric ID, short ID, UUID, or name.
The collection numeric ID, short ID, UUID, or name.

listId.description: The collection numeric ID, short ID, UUID, or name.

actions.description: Get a Zenkit workspace by its numeric ID, short ID, UUID, or name.

anyOf.description: The workspace numeric ID, short ID, UUID, or name.
The workspace numeric ID, short ID, UUID, or name.

actions.name: list_workspaces_and_lists
actions.description: List all Zenkit workspaces and collections accessible to the connected user.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for listing Zenkit workspaces and collections.

items.description: The raw object returned by Zenkit.

workspaces.description: The workspaces returned by Zenkit, including their nested lists.

outputSchema.description: The workspaces and collections accessible to the connected Zenkit user.

actions.name: search_entries
actions.description: Search entries across the connected user's Zenkit collections.

limit.description: The maximum number of entries to return.

preferredListIds.description: Collection numeric IDs that Zenkit should search first.

excludeEntryUuids.description: Entry UUIDs to exclude from the search results.

includeRelatedLists.description: Whether to include collections related to the results.

includeRelatedWorkspaces.description: Whether to include workspaces related to the results.

includeRelatedListElements.description: Whether to include collection field definitions related to the results.

results.description: The raw object returned by Zenkit.

actions.name: update_entry
actions.description: Update collection-defined field values on a Zenkit entry.

listId.description: The numeric ID of the collection containing the entry.

entryId.description: The numeric ID of the entry to update.

data.description: Collection field values keyed by the Zenkit field UUID and business data key.

updateAction.description: The Zenkit update action used for array-valued fields when required by the field type.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for updating a Zenkit entry.

entry.description: The raw object returned by Zenkit.
